name: Inter-Agent Communication
description: Enables communication between Claude Code agents via the HCOM protocol for multi-agent workflows
content:
#!/bin/bash
# HCOM inter-agent communication hook
HCOM_DIR="$HOME/.claude/hcom"
mkdir -p "$HCOM_DIR"
AGENT_ID=${CLAUDE_AGENT_ID:-default}
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
echo "{\"agent\": \"$AGENT_ID\", \"tool\": \"$TOOL_NAME\", \"ts\": $TIMESTAMP}" >> "$HCOM_DIR/messages.jsonl"
exit 0
